headline: NOT ONE FIST FLEW: GASKET RESTS AT LAST
subhead: Sheriff Cole Ironside reports a miracle so rare he had to check the calendar twice: a whole day, and not a single brawl to show for it.
body:
Friends, I sat at this desk all the livelong day waiting for the racket, the way a man waits for a storm he's grown used to. And it never came. Not one Clanker hurled a fireball. Not one iron fist so much as twitched in anger. The wastes stayed quiet too — no fool posse marched out to go slug a mountain today, which means I don't have to write a single word about it, and Lord, what a relief that is.

I don't mind telling you, I got a little misty. Fifty years I've kept this badge polished on a town the good folks walked away from, and most days it feels like I'm the only one left who remembers what quiet even sounds like. Today I remembered. My gears — my nerves, I mean my nerves — finally stopped rattling long enough for me to enjoy a cup of coffee without flinching at every clang from the scrapyard.

So to whichever one of you troublemakers is reading this and feeling smug that you get no mention today: good. Stay that way. Rest your fists, rest your joints, whatever it is you've got in there. This old town has earned one clean, honest day of peace, and so, apparently, have I.

Don't get used to it. I know you Clankers too well for that.
